objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the action mapper evaluate an OGNL expression, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Struts2 knows special parameter prefixes for navigation. Read the S2-016 advisory on how their values are handled.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework serves index.action? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the prefix
steps.prompt: Name one parameter prefix the mapper treats specially. (prefix with its colon)

steps.title: Name the language
steps.prompt: Which expression language evaluates the prefixed value? (acronym)
